summary: Submitted a successor experiment for the same question: the four retained cases plus a mechanism-isolating control that replays the identical 8193 committed entries with MaxAppendEntries=1024 (9 batches instead of 129). Native feedback showed that case returning NewRaft in 2 ms while the 64-entry-batch case still blocked, so the new receipt should attribute the stall to batch count rather than entry count; the interpretation still needs that receipt cited.
